arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Seth Waxman argued for Dow Chemical. He cited a 1984 final judgment. He claimed it binds the class.
Isaac Smoger argued for Stephenson. He stated Stephenson had no 1984 injury. He claimed state law allows late claims.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Dow Chemical seeks to dismiss Stephenson's cancer lawsuit. It claims a 1984 class action already resolved these issues. Stephenson wants to proceed with his 1999 cancer claim. He argues state law permits late filing.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Dow Chemical wants the court to dismiss the lawsuit. It seeks to enforce the 1984 class judgment.
Stephenson wants the court to allow his lawsuit. He seeks to pursue his 1999 cancer claim.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Dow Chemical argues a final judgment binds the class. It claims this judgment includes Stephenson.
Stephenson argues he had no injury in 1984. He claims state law allows his 1999 filing.
